svg.title: Unbiasedness and consistency are independent properties
svg.desc: Two columns of three stacked sampling densities at n equal to five, forty and two hundred. The left column, the first observation used alone as the estimator, is centred on theta at every n and never narrows. The right column, the sample maximum, sits below theta at every n and narrows sharply onto it.
svg.text: every curve is drawn to the same height, and within a column the horizontal scale is shared
unbiased at every n, never consistent
On the left the spread at n = 200 equals the spread at n = 5, so the estimator never settles anywhere. On the
right the bias is never zero, and yet both the bias and the spread shrink like 1 / n.
